api.title: API eo am - Ruo-Ial in Deloñ ñan Jabdewōt System
api.intro: Jabdewōt system ippān API key eo am emaron kōmmane, riiti im kōkāāl lead ko im subscribe ñan lead event ko. Jilkinlok kii eo ilo <hdr></hdr> header eo, einwot <bearer></bearer> , ak (elañe kein jerbal eo ejjab maroñ in kōmman header ko) einwot <query></query> . Limit: {{limit}} kajjitōk ko ilo juon minit.
